name: crm
description: Lead / contact CRM with Excel import - Next.js + Node.js + MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n db,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n db,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run db -w server" "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w client"
